response.overview: Away up in the heart of the Canadian Rockies, at Lake Louise, Laggan, the beauty spot of North America, which is justly celebrated for the magnificence of its scenery, this motion picture plot is laid amidst the snow-capped peaks and eternal glaciers of that region where nature has done her finest work for mankind to feast its eyes upon. The story deals' with human love and passion, weakness and infidelity, all centered around a romantic-looking Swiss guide and his pretty wife, who are located at Lake Louise (a summer resort) for the purpose of guiding tourists over the dangerous passes and deep crevasses of the glaciers which lie surrounded by huge mountains at the foot of this God's Mirror. One of the guests of the Chalet Hotel is a young and beautiful girl. The rough mountain guide soon falls under the spell of her beauty, and she, all unknowingly, is playing havoc with his heart...
response.title: The Swiss Guide
